#!/bin/bash
set -u

BASE="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp"
ENV_DIR="$BASE/envs/openwebui"
PY="$ENV_DIR/bin/python"
CLI="$ENV_DIR/bin/open-webui"
DATA_DIR="$BASE/openwebui-data"
HF_HOME="$BASE/huggingface"
LOG="$BASE/openwebui-runtime.log"
SECRET_FILE="$BASE/.webui_secret_key"

export HOME="$BASE"
export DATA_DIR="$DATA_DIR"
export HF_HOME="$HF_HOME"
export SENTENCE_TRANSFORMERS_HOME="$HF_HOME"
export USE_CUDA_DOCKER=false
export ENABLE_WEBSOCKET_SUPPORT=false
export UVICORN_WORKERS=1
export ENV=prod
export GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
export CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN="https://powerpc-darwin.org;https://www.powerpc-darwin.org"
export ENABLE_VERSION_UPDATE_CHECK=false
export WEBUI_AUTH=True
# Public OpenWebUI traffic terminates TLS at the Fasthosts reverse proxy.
# Mark all OpenWebUI session/auth cookies Secure at the application layer.
export WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=true
export WEBUI_AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=true
export WEBUI_SESSION_COOKIE_SAME_SITE=lax
export WEBUI_AUTH_COOKIE_SAME_SITE=lax
export PATH="$ENV_DIR/bin:$BASE/miniconda/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
export LANG=C
export LC_ALL=C
export OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434
export OLLAMA_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/api
# DeepSeek-R1 is a thinking-capable Ollama model. Keep the UI on the native
# Ollama chat path; model-level think=false is applied in the model settings.
export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096
export AIOHTTP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT=300
export OPENWEBUI_TOOL_RESULT_MODEL_CHAR_CAP=16384
export OPENWEBUI_TOOL_RESULT_MODEL_TURN_CHAR_CAP=32768
export OPENWEBUI_TOOL_RESULT_MODEL_MIN_CHAR_CAP=2048
export OPENWEBUI_TOOL_CALL_REPLAY_CAP=96
# Continuity compaction narrow-node pipeline: local embeddings + deterministic
# extractive classification. Generative compaction is retained only as fallback.
export OPENWEBUI_CONTINUITY_EXTRACTIVE_ONLY=1
export OPENWEBUI_CONTINUITY_REDUCER_TARGET_CHARS=16000
export OPENWEBUI_CONTINUITY_REDUCER_RECENT_CHARS=6000
export OPENWEBUI_CONTINUITY_REDUCER_EMBED_CHARS=2200
export OPENWEBUI_CONTINUITY_REDUCER_ITEM_CHARS=2400
export AUDIO_TTS_ENGINE=openai
export AUDIO_TTS_MODEL=kokoro
export AUDIO_TTS_VOICE=ahsoka
export AUDIO_TTS_SPLIT_ON=punctuation
export AUDIO_TTS_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18082/v1
export AUDIO_TTS_OPENAI_API_KEY=local-kokoro

umask 077
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR" "$HF_HOME"

if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then
    echo "FATAL: Python runtime missing: $PY"
    exit 20
fi

if [ ! -x "$CLI" ]; then
    echo "FATAL: Open WebUI CLI missing: $CLI"
    exit 21
fi

if [ ! -s "$SECRET_FILE" ]; then
    "$PY" - "$SECRET_FILE" <<'PY'
import secrets, sys
path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))
PY
    chmod 600 "$SECRET_FILE"
fi

export WEBUI_SECRET_KEY="$(cat "$SECRET_FILE")"

# Ensure the local OpenAI broker is present before OpenWebUI starts.
# Failure remains fail-closed for OpenAI, but does not take local models/UI offline.
BROKER_RUN="$BASE/openai-token-broker/run-broker.sh"
BROKER_HEALTH="http://127.0.0.1:18081/__broker/health"
BROKER_STATE="PASS"
BROKER_RC=0
if ! curl -fsS --max-time 1 "$BROKER_HEALTH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    BROKER_STATE="STARTING"
    if [ -x "$BROKER_RUN" ]; then
        "$BROKER_RUN" || BROKER_RC=$?
    else
        BROKER_RC=127
    fi
    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
        curl -fsS --max-time 1 "$BROKER_HEALTH" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { BROKER_STATE="PASS"; break; }
        sleep .25
    done
    if [ "$BROKER_STATE" != "PASS" ]; then BROKER_STATE="FAIL_CLOSED"; fi
fi

# Kokoro TTS is optional and independently supervised. OpenWebUI startup may
# request a bounded health ensure, but an explicit operator disable is authoritative.
KOKORO_CTL="$BASE/bin/kokoro-service"
KOKORO_HEALTH="http://127.0.0.1:18082/health"
KOKORO_STATE="PASS"
if [ -e "$BASE/.kokoro-service/disabled" ]; then
    KOKORO_STATE="DISABLED"
elif ! curl -fsS --max-time 1 "$KOKORO_HEALTH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    KOKORO_STATE="STARTING"
    if [ -x "$KOKORO_CTL" ]; then
        "$KOKORO_CTL" ensure >>"$LOG" 2>&1 &
    else
        KOKORO_STATE="UNAVAILABLE"
    fi
fi

echo "=== OPENWEBUI_RUNTIME_START_PROXY_V1 ==="
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
echo "pid=$$"
echo "python=$("$PY" --version 2>&1)"
echo "cli=$CLI"
echo "data_dir=$DATA_DIR"
echo "hf_home=$HF_HOME"
echo "bind=127.0.0.1:18080"
echo "websocket_support=$ENABLE_WEBSOCKET_SUPPORT"
echo "uvicorn_workers=$UVICORN_WORKERS"
echo "cuda=$USE_CUDA_DOCKER"
echo "secret_file=$SECRET_FILE"
echo "secret_file_mode=$(stat -c '%a' "$SECRET_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)"
echo "openai_broker_state=$BROKER_STATE"
echo "openai_broker_start_rc=$BROKER_RC"
echo "kokoro_tts_state=$KOKORO_STATE"
echo

exec "$CLI" serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18080
